glosses: reform (the change of something that is defective, broken, inefficient or otherwise negative)
pension (gratuity paid regularly as benefit due to a person in consideration of past services)

examples.text: A reforma pode ser uma coisa ruim?
examples.en: Can reform be a bad thing?

examples.text: O político propôs reformas no congresso.
examples.en: The politician proposed reforms to Congress.

examples.text: A casa que Tom comprou precisa muito de uma reforma.
examples.en: The house that Tom bought is a real fixer-upper.

examples.text: Fizemos numerosas reformas em casa desde que a compramos.
examples.en: We've made numerous improvements to our house since we bought it.
